description: Implementation of system information functions such as CPU count, CPU frequency, and thread ID retrieval for different platforms, used internally within the Abseil library.

classes.name: UnscaledCycleClockWrapperForInitializeFrequency
classes.description: Wrapper class providing access to the high-resolution cycle clock for frequency measurement.

classes.name: TimeTscPair
classes.description: Structure holding a pair of timestamp and TSC (Time Stamp Counter) value for frequency measurement.

methods.name: Win32CountSetBits
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set in a bitmask on Windows.

methods.name: Win32NumCPUs
methods.description: Calculates the number of logical CPUs on Windows using system information.

methods.name: GetNumCPUs
methods.description: Determines the number of CPUs based on platform-specific methods.

methods.name: GetNominalCPUFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves the nominal CPU frequency on various platforms, including Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Linux.

methods.name: ReadLongFromFile
methods.description: Reads a long integer value from a specified file.

methods.name: ReadMonotonicClockNanos
methods.description: Reads a monotonic clock value in nanoseconds.

methods.name: GetTimeTscPair
methods.description: Obtains a pair of timestamp and TSC value with minimal latency.

methods.name: MeasureTscFrequencyWithSleep
methods.description: Measures TSC frequency by sleeping for a specified duration.

methods.name: MeasureTscFrequency
methods.description: Estimates the TSC frequency by repeated measurements.

methods.name: NumCPUs
methods.description: Returns the number of CPUs, initialized once.

methods.name: NominalCPUFrequency
methods.description: Returns the CPU frequency, initialized once.

methods.name: GetTID
methods.description: Retrieves the thread ID for various platforms.

methods.name: GetCachedTID
methods.description: Returns the thread ID cached in thread-local storage for efficiency.
